purpose: The only native PostgreSQL tests that may be skipped in the combined-schema CI job, each with the reason. A skip is never counted as a pass. An entry that no longer skips fails the contract, so it must be removed.

skippedTests.title: refuses an altered legacy policy and preserves the entire security state and history
skippedTests.reason: Separate released-to-current cohort: it converges a supplied genuine released-topology (legacy) template, which needs UE_CURRENT_SECURITY_NATIVE_PROOF=1, UE_CURRENT_SECURITY_LEGACY_OWNER_URL and UE_CURRENT_SECURITY_ADMIN_URL with UE_NATIVE_TEMPLATE_URL unset. This job builds only the canonical template and runs no legacy-topology database, so the file skips itself; that transition is not proven here.
